in_marathi.name: Roshni
in_marathi.long_meaning: Roshni हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Roshni is a name of great significance in Hindu culture. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Rohan', meaning 'to move'. The name Roshni signifies the light that illuminates the path for someone, guiding them through their life. Roshni is often considered a symbol of knowledge, wisdom, and spiritual enlightenment.
